hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; if [ -f "$d/scripts/run-python.sh" ]; then sh "$d/scripts/run-python.sh" "$d/scripts/campaign_guard.py" stop-hook; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$d/scripts/campaign_guard.py" stop-hook; else python "$d/scripts/campaign_guard.py" stop-hook; fi

d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; if [ -f "$d/scripts/run-python.sh" ]; then sh "$d/scripts/run-python.sh" "$d/scripts/dispatch_hook.py"; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$d/scripts/dispatch_hook.py"; else python "$d/scripts/dispatch_hook.py"; fi

d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; if [ -f "$d/scripts/run-python.sh" ]; then sh "$d/scripts/run-python.sh" "$d/scripts/ci_status.py" --gate --brief; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$d/scripts/ci_status.py" --gate --brief; else python "$d/scripts/ci_status.py" --gate --brief; fi
